Cached metadata-only Webpack baseline at finder-data:baselines/webpack-latest.json so 6-hour CI runs reuse it without re-booting Webpack Chrome and keep working after stable migrates to Vite.
Inlined ephemeral localhost image/font URLs inside --with-previews as base64 data URIs and scoped html.GamepadMode selectors onto .preview-stage.GamepadMode with a gpfocus simulator toggle.
